n: Two pieces of research this week point at the same habit. One checks whether a model gets easy questions right every time, and the other scores how sure a model is so the shaky answers go to a person. You can do both by hand. Ask the same question twice and see if the answer holds. Then decide ahead of time which kinds of answers you will always check yourself: numbers, names, dates, anything you would sign.
